BiblicalUsage: Chadlai is named once, as the father of Amasa, one of the heads of Ephraim who stood against bringing the captives of Judah to Samaria. His son's stand is the only thing the record keeps of him, and it is enough.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Amasa's mercy is Chadlai's memorial — a son's stand can be a father's whole story.
